verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web-data API. A built-in assistant is a plausible feature for a SaaS product like this, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server, CLI, and coding-agent skill serve external agents. The Answers endpoint is an API call for web research, not an in-product assistant, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
